text: Managing a team successfully requires several important skills. First, clear communication is essential, because team members need to understand their tasks and goals. A good manager also knows how to delegate work effectively, giving each person responsibilities that match their strengths. Regular feedback helps employees improve and feel valued. Motivation is another key factor, as happy and engaged workers perform better. Finally, when conflicts arise, a manager should listen to both sides and find fair solutions. By combining these skills, a manager can build a strong, productive team where everyone feels supported and respected.
